description: This PHP class 'EmployeeNumber' extends 'FilterField' and implements 'ValueXNormalizable' to handle employee number filtering in HRM report queries. It defines methods to modify query builder with employee number conditions, convert employee data to array, and retrieve entity aliases. Uses traits and external classes related to Employee service and ORM query building.

classes.name: EmployeeNumber
classes.description: A filtering class for employee number fields in HRM reports, enabling query modifications and data normalization.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to include a condition on employee number if the operator is EQUAL and the value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns aliases used in the query, here 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts an employee number value into an array containing employee's id, label (name), and termination status if the employee exists.
